meta.title: Electromagnetic/Electrostatic Balance Thrust Stand
meta.description: Starthermatech electromagnetic/electrostatic balance thrust stand uses closed-loop feedback to cancel thrust, with high bandwidth and linearity for μN-N steady and pulsed thrust measurement. Supports PID+DSP control, voice coil/electrostatic force feedback, and electrical calibration, suitable for dynamic thrust noise and fast-response scenarios.
page.title: Electromagnetic/Electrostatic Balance Thrust Stand
page.lead: High-bandwidth, high-linearity thrust stand for dynamic and pulsed measurements.
detail.title: EM/ES Balance Thrust Stand
detail.tagline: Fast response, good linearity, in-situ electrical calibration
detail.overview: Uses electromagnetic or electrostatic force in closed-loop to counter thrust, keeping the arm near zero. Feedback force proportional to coil current or electrode voltage yields precise thrust. High stiffness and vibration immunity suit pulsed thrust and thrust noise measurements.
detail.feature1: High bandwidth for pulsed thrust and thrust noise
detail.feature2: Minimal mechanical nonlinearity, excellent force-to-signal linearity
detail.feature3: Electrical readout ready for digital/PID+DSP control
detail.feature4: Fast in-situ EM/ES calibration; high stiffness and vibration tolerance
